objective: Help developers diagnose whitespace-free multilingual document ingestion and connect exact-fit collection work to the existing LKT sample and USD 250 service.

source_need.title: Web SDK RAG chunker makes a whitespace-free CJK document one unbounded chunk
source_need.problem: A TypeScript ingestion path sizes chunks from non-whitespace regex matches, leaving a long whitespace-free CJK passage as one unbounded unit.
source_need.engagement: Research only. No comment, issue claim, private message, pull request or implementation commitment.

fit.supported_value: A tested language-independent hard-cap example with exact source locators, plus clear distinctions between whitespace units, Unicode code points, UTF-16 offsets, grapheme clusters and embedding tokens.
fit.exclusions: Not an upstream SDK patch, semantic chunker, embedding benchmark, tokenizer implementation, full-book ingestion result or customer delivery.

owned_article.title: Why Your Chinese Document Becomes One Giant RAG Chunk

commercial_route.sequence: Useful standalone article, public sample, free fit check, accepted written scope, reviewed payment request, confirmed payment, delivery.
